ttl.name: Rear Door Belt Moulding Assembly LH

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Belt Moulding Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Engage the 8 claws to install the rear door belt moulding assembly LH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Glass Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Slide the rear door glass RH as shown in the illustration and install it to the rear door window regulator RH.

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage the rear door glass RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Quarter Window Glass LH

s2.ptxt: Install the rear door quarter window glass RH to the rear door quarter window weatherstrip RH.
Install the rear door quarter window glass RH together with the rear door quarter window weatherstrip RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Window Division Bar Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Insert the rear door window division bar RH from above the vehicle, and install it with the 2 bolts and screw.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Glass Run LH

s2.ptxt: Install the rear door glass run RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Service Hole Cover LH

s2.ptxt: Apply butyl tape to the door panel side.
Pass each connector, the rear door lock remote control cable RH and rear door inside locking cable RH through a new rear door service hole cover RH.
Align a new rear door service hole cover RH with the reference position on the rear door panel and attach it.

atten3.ptxt: Attach the rear door service hole cover RH so that there are no wrinkles or lifting, and press it down firmly.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Glass Weatherstrip Inner LH

s2.ptxt: Install the rear door glass weatherstrip inner RH to the rear door panel.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Inside Handle Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Install the rear door lock remote control cable RH and rear door inside locking cable RH to the rear door inside handle RH.
Engage the 2 claws to install the rear door inside handle RH to the rear door trim board RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Trim Board Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Engage the 3 claws to install the rear door trim board RH to the rear door glass weatherstrip inner RH.
Engage the 9 clips to install the rear door trim board RH to the rear door panel.

s-1.ptxt: Install Door Assist Grip Cover LH

s2.ptxt: Engage the 4 claws to install the door assist grip cover RH to the rear door trim board RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Inside Handle Bezel LH

s2.ptxt: Engage the 3 claws to install the rear door inside handle bezel RH to the rear door trim board RH.
